notes.claim: The new Elwynn Forest quest 'Applejack Still' (91736, an object north of Westbrook Garrison at about 24.6, 58.0) takes 4 Shiny Red Apples and gives a Thunder Applejack plus 100 XP each turn-in; a beta player reports it can be repeated without limit.
notes.title: Elwynn Applejack Still: 4 Shiny Red Apples for a Thunder Applejack and 100 XP, reportedly repeatable
notes.detail: The Thunder Applejack is the item for 'An Apple Treat' (91738, Sergeant De Vries at Westbrook Garrison, 630 XP), so one turn-in is part of the normal Elwynn route; Polestar buys 4 apples from Homer Stonefield (NPC 894, Stonefield farm) for it. The repeat XP comes from one forum post (Oct 18) asking whether it is an exploit; no staff reply yet. ForeverGuide's client-derived quest data flags 91736 as a 'special' object quest with req level 0. Expect a hotfix if it really repeats; for the coach: do it once for An Apple Treat, and treat repeat farming as unconfirmed (apples are a vendor item, so XP per copper would be very high at levels 1-8).

notes.claim: On the current beta build (70450), any spell haste (e.g. Troll Berserking, Skyborne Wind Blessed 3% haste) shortens the 1.5 s global cooldown, according to a forever-bugs maintainer replying to a Berserking report (#389, Oct 18).
notes.title: Beta: all spell haste currently lowers the global cooldown
notes.detail: Report #389 'Berserking lowers the GCD' is open and Pending Approval; the reply is from a repository collaborator, not a confirmed Blizzard designer. Whether this is intended is unknown; Classic Era haste never lowered the GCD. For leveling it slightly speeds instant-spam casters (Shaman shocks, Warlock DoTs, Paladin seals) under haste; don't model it until Blizzard says.

notes.claim: In client build 70425, spell 24867 'Feral Swiftness' (learn level 8) changed its text from +30% to +15% movement speed in Cat Form; the Feral Swiftness talent (17002) still reads +30% and +4% dodge.
notes.title: Datamined: level-8 'Feral Swiftness' (24867) Cat Form speed 30% -> 15%
notes.detail: Not in the Oct 15 notes. Unclear whether 24867 is a baseline passive or the talent's effect; check Cat Form run speed in game before changing travel estimates for Druids.

notes.claim: Polestar (fitzforge/polestar, v0.2.5 Oct 17, CurseForge 'polestar-guides', ~100 GitHub stars in 4 days) ships step-by-step 1-60 routes for every race start, chosen by simulating millions of routes per start; its model estimates 117-121 /played hours to 60 solo.
notes.title: Polestar: free open-source Forever guide addon with simulated 1-60 routes
notes.detail: The hours are model estimates, not measurements: it uses the Classic kill-XP formula (45+5*level, elites x2), the client QuestXP table with difficulty tiers, run speed 7 yd/s, grinding weighted 2.5x and 7.5 min per zone change; Forever's 30-60 zones aren't in its data yet. Has a recorder module, group and profession steps and a Discord. Large data: addon/Polestar_Guides/Guides.lua (6 MB), guides/forever/, tools/planner, docs/SIMULATION.md. Useful cross-check for Glide's route ranking.

notes.claim: Everloot (CDVolvik/everloot, everloot.app) is an addon plus site that publishes anonymous in-game observations (drops, vendors, recipes, trainers, prices) as facts once at least three installs report them, under CC BY-SA 4.0, with MCP endpoints for AI assistants.
notes.title: Everloot: crowdsourced Forever drop rates, spawns and trainers (published at 3+ reports)
notes.detail: New on Oct 17 (beta, addon 0.2.6). Could later supply measured quest-item drop rates and spawn points for Glide's kill-count estimates. Needs an adapter; check its data release format.

notes.claim: Kaivax said on Oct 16 that a Beta hotfix fixed the bug that stopped druids from looting the relics needed for the Cat Form quest.
notes.title: Druid Cat Form quest: relic looting fixed by Beta hotfix (Oct 16)
notes.detail: Cat Form is a quest reward in Forever; until the fix the quest could not be finished (forever-bugs #362 'still bugged' on Oct 16 morning).
